question: I am performing a comparative study on the quality of life in G20 countries. According to the University of Toronto's G7 Information Center 2010 Fact Sheets "G8 and G20 Demographics", and "G8 and G20 Economic Indicators", which G20 countries have a population growth rate that is positive, a birth rate that is over 10/1000, a life expectancy over 80.00 years old, and a 2009 unemployment rate less than 9.50%?

answer:
Based on the data from the University of Toronto's G7 Information Center 2010 Fact Sheets, let me systematically check which G20 countries meet ALL four criteria:

**Criteria:**
1. Population growth rate > 0 (positive)
2. Birth rate > 10/1,000
3. Life expectancy > 80.00 years
4. 2009 unemployment rate < 9.50%

**Analysis of Data:**

| Country | Pop Growth | Birth Rate (/1k) | Life Exp (yrs) | Unemployment 2009 | Meets All? |
|---------|------------|------------------|----------------|-------------------|------------|
| **Canada** | +0.170% ✓ | 10.28 ✓ | 81.23 ✓ | 8.28% ✓ | **YES** |
| Australia | +1.195% ✓ | 12.47 ✓ | 81.63 ✓ | 5.60% ✓ | **YES** |
| France | -0.053% ✗ | 12.57 ✓ | 80.98 ✓ | 9.39% ✓ | No (pop growth neg) |
| Germany | -0.047% ✗ | 8.18 ✗ | 79.26 ✗ | 7.44% ✓ | No (multiple fail) |
| Italy | -0.047% ✗ | 8.18 ✗ | 80.2 ✓ | 7.75% ✓ | No (pop growth neg, birth rate low) |
| Japan | -0.191% ✗ | 7.64 ✗ | 82.12 ✓ | 5.08% ✓ | No (pop growth neg, birth rate low) |
| Russia | -0.467% ✗ | 11.1 ✓ | 66.03 ✗ | 8.40% ✓ | No (all except birth) |
| UK | +0.279% ✓ | 10.65 ✓ | 79.01 ✗ | 7.46% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| US | +0.977% ✓ | 13.83 ✓ | 78.11 ✗ | 9.28% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| Argentina | +1.053% ✓ | 17.94 ✓ | 76.56 ✗ | 8.40% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| Brazil | +1.199% ✓ | 18.43 ✓ | 71.99 ✗ | 6.80% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| China | +0.655% ✓ | 14 ✓ | 73.47 ✗ | 3.66% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| India | +1.407% ✓ | 21.72 ✓ | 66.09 ✗ | 9.50% ✗ | No (life exp < 80, unemp = 9.50 not < 9.50) |
| Indonesia | +1.136% ✓ | 18.84 ✓ | 70.76 ✗ | 0.95% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| Korea | +0.266% ✓ | 8.93 ✗ | 78.72 ✗ | 5.00% ✓ | No (birth rate < 10, life exp < 80) |
| Mexico | +1.13% ✓ | 19.71 ✓ | 76.06 ✗ | 5.50% ✓ | No (life exp < 80) |
| Saudi Arabia | +1.848% ✓ | 28.55 ✓ | 76.3 ✗ | 11.80% ✗ | No (life exp < 80, unemp > 9.50) |
| South Africa | +0.281% ✓ | 19.93 ✓ | 48.98 ✗ | 24.30% ✗ | No (multiple fail) |
| Turkey | +1.312% ✓ | 18.66 ✓ | 71.96 ✗ | 14.10% ✗ | No (life exp < 80, unemp > 9.50) |

## Answer

According to the University of Toronto's G7 Information Center 2010 Fact Sheets, **only two G20 countries meet all four criteria**:

1. **Canada** - Population growth: +0.170%, Birth rate: 10.28/1,000, Life expectancy: 81.23 years, 2009 unemployment: 8.28%

2. **Australia** - Population growth: +1.195%, Birth rate: 12.47/1,000, Life expectancy: 81.63 years, 2009 unemployment: 5.60%
